proposed_decision.status: sourced candidate; coordinated macro amendment required before installation
proposed_decision.name: Minamitorishima / Marcus Island
proposed_decision.finite_scope: The complete named Minamitorishima/Marcus Island emergent land footprint and directly attached sourced shoreline features only. Excludes Japan main/Ryukyu/Izu–Bonin/Volcano/Daito island families, surrounding EEZ, seamount chains and other unnamed Japanese territories. No nearest-polygon transfer.
proposed_decision.rule: This named isolated coral Pacific island follows Northwestern Pacific → Micronesia → Oceania. Japanese sovereignty and Ogasawara administrative attachment remain separate modern owner/context. The retained geographic standard deliberately distinguishes Marcus from Bonin/Volcano islands.
basis: Direct geographic classification MCS-OO → region 62 Northwestern Pacific in WGSRPD edition 2, consistent with the current Northwestern Pacific regional branch.
Official JMA physical description corroborates the detached low coral island rather than main Japanese volcanic-arc membership.

Marianas/Maug and Wake already belong to Northwestern Pacific/Micronesia. More than 1000 km of open ocean separates Marcus from neighboring islands, so this named restoration does not move a shared mainland boundary.

alternative_considered.rationale: An explicit Ogasawara-associated cartographic exception could be chosen, but municipal attachment or modern Japanese sovereignty alone is insufficient. Such a choice would depart from the retained standard’s explicit exclusion of Marcus from Eastern Asia and require a separate geographic justification.

neighbor_compatibility.Japan_explicit_exclusion_required: Name Marcus/Minamitorishima as excluded while retaining the main/Ryukyu/Izu–Bonin/Volcano/Daito associations.
neighbor_compatibility.NorthwesternPacific_explicit_inclusion_r: Include the named Marcus outlier in fixed land scope and routing. Do not invent an encompassing archipelago or move all Japanese islands into Oceania.
neighbor_compatibility.outer_envelope_change_if_restored: A new disconnected named land component requires a coordinated geographic release/certificate; published version 3 remains immutable.
neighbor_compatibility.province_area_parents: Handle through bounded regional engineering or source-backed restoration. Do not attach Marcus to a Wake/Mariana administrative unit because of proximity.

limitations: WGSRPD is a botanical geographic standard; its flora-based distinction supports an explicit reporting convention rather than unique continental geology.
JMA and the peer-reviewed article corroborate identity and oceanic setting; neither independently defines a continent.
Candidate OSM land area is about 1.456 km² versus rounded official area 1.51 km². Source footprint accuracy and shoreline vintage still require engineering review.
Regional interiors, province/area membership, pixel representation and dated history are not approved by this proposal.
Modern Japanese ownership must not backfill ancient ownership or generate historical political boundaries.
required_engineering_action: Approve the finite named route with reciprocal Japan/Northwestern Pacific/Micronesia/Oceania scope annotations. Then accept sourced geometry through a coordinated release and representation audit, retaining predecessor versions and original evidence.
